question.prompt:
The lateral surface of a cone unfolds into a sector with radius 6 and central angle \(120^\circ\). Find the base radius of this cone.

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_258_q5_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: The sector's arc length is \(120\pi\times 6/180=4\pi\), which equals the base circumference \(2\pi r\), so \(r=2\).
solutions.title: Match the sector arc to the base circumference
